points.identity_evidence: Eastern tributary of Glendyer N03 splits into northeast and eastern arms just upstream of its main-stem mouth. Northern arm rises through settlement plots; the east arm continues below the plots. Same catchment as N03, weak additional spatial support.
points.review: Agent native crosshair and branch topology audit before trial scoring; 6967,1507 lies at the NE/east tributary split. Existing N03 supplies downstream context, not independent validation.
